result:
Experiment 4 is pre-registered in `runs/pending_experiment.json`. The only file created is that one; no `model/` or frozen file was touched.

**What the history says.** Experiment 2 made the three training surveys converge (0.05 to 0.09 each) while the held-out 2024 photograph barely moved (1.651 to 1.583). Experiment 3 tried to forbid per-survey fingerprints with a cosine consistency loss and was reverted, but its own log shows the term never bit: the cross-survey cosine was already 0.966 at epoch 1 on a fresh network, because post-ReLU pooled features are non-negative and share a large common component. That refutation is of a vacuous constraint, not of feature invariance. I recorded this in the hypothesis so a later agent can retest it with batch-centred features.

**A design-stage probe on experiment 2's exported model** (frozen scorer's 400 eval crops, not part of the record) located the brittleness:

| input | mission | usable | false fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| truedop_2023 (training photo), raw | 0.087 | 94.3% | 3.0% |
| same, +20 on every pixel | 1.240 | 14.7% | 38.8% |
| same, -20 | 1.550 | 6.8% | 61.8% |
| same, 1 px blur | 1.100 | 20.5% | 30.5% |
| truedop_2024 (held out), raw | 1.583 | 7.0% | 65.2% |
| 2024, globally colour-matched to 2023 | 1.365 | 10.0% | 46.5% |

Three surveys with three colour balances were absorbed as three pixel-exact fingerprints, exactly like the one-photograph champion. Global colour matching recovers only a fifth of the 2024 gap, and 2024 is softer and lower-contrast than any training survey, so the rest rides survey-specific 1 m texture and shadows.

**The experiment.** Per-view photometric and sharpness nuisance randomisation on the GPU in `model/train.py`: Gaussian blur, exposure and per-channel gain, contrast, brightness, gamma, saturation, sensor noise, all drawn independently per view. Nothing else changes, and the exported graph is identical. The blur component is the load-bearing one for the cross-survey question, since the model demonstrably depends on 1 m texture that no two surveys share.

**Pre-registered predictions.** Held-out 2024 from 1.583 to 1.15 to 1.40, false fix from 65% to 35 to 50%, usable from 7% to 15 to 30%. Training diagnostics worsen mildly to 0.08 to 0.25. A mechanical check is written into the outcome: the +20, -20 and blur probes on the training photo must drop below 0.3, or the augmentation was not applied. Decision rules name the next move for each outcome: cross-survey structure via centred-feature consistency, aligned cross-survey patch mixing, or distillation.
